# Langford | Ramos

## Home

Criminal defense.

---

## Attorneys

### Trial attorneys.

Both partners handle serious criminal matters in state and federal court, and both remain personally involved in the cases they take.

### Michael J. Langford

Partner

Langford represents people at every stage of the criminal process in state and federal court. His practice is focused on serious criminal defense, with direct involvement in investigation, preparation, negotiation, and trial.

### Alexander E. Ramos

Partner

Ramos is a former Assistant Federal Public Defender. He has represented hundreds of people charged with federal offenses, including drug trafficking, homicide, firearms offenses, fraud, and money laundering.

---

## Practice

Langford | Ramos represents people facing criminal investigations and charges in state and federal court.

The firm is deliberately focused. It handles serious criminal matters from investigation through trial.

### Federal Criminal Defense.

Langford | Ramos represents people facing federal investigation and prosecution. The firm handles federal matters from pre-charge investigation through indictment, motions, trial, and sentencing.

### State Criminal Defense.

The firm represents people charged in Utah state courts in serious felony and misdemeanor matters. Representation may begin before charges are filed and continue through trial.

### Investigations

Langford | Ramos represents people facing criminal investigation before formal charges are filed. That work may include contact with law enforcement, subpoenas, search warrants, and other pre-charge matters.

### Cases we handle:

Murder, manslaughter, aggravated assault, robbery, burglary, kidnapping, rape, sexual assault, arson, domestic violence, stalking, DUI, drug possession, drug distribution, drug trafficking, firearms offenses, felon in possession, theft, fraud, identity theft, wire fraud, mail fraud, bank fraud, healthcare fraud, tax crimes, money laundering, conspiracy, racketeering, obstruction of justice, witness tampering, cybercrime.
